title: Manager Enablement and IC-to-Manager Transition Guide
author: Priya Kapoor
body:
Summary
This guide explains the operational, people, and tooling steps for individual contributors (ICs) who are promoted or hired into manager roles at Redwood Inference. It is intended to reduce time-to-impact for new managers and standardize expectations across teams.

Scope
- Applies to all IC-to-manager transitions (first-line manager and manager-of-managers bootstraps) across engineering, product, and customer-facing teams.
- Covers the first 12 months (90/180/365 day milestones), required training, access & tooling matrix, compensation and benefits adjustments, probation & review cadence, and a checklist for hiring or backfilling the IC role.

Owner and escalation
- Owner: People Ops (people-ops)
- Escalation: People Ops lead (people-ops@redwood.ai) -> HR Business Partner -> VP of People

Outcome expectations
- Establish clear people management responsibilities within 30 days.
- Demonstrate competency in core manager skills (1:1s, feedback, hiring) within 90 days.
- Run a full performance cycle and hiring loop (where applicable) within 180–365 days.

90/180/365 Day transition timeline
- Day 0–30 (Orientation):
  1) Accept manager role and complete role acknowledgement form in HRIS.
  2) Meet with manager peer buddy and assigned People Ops partner.
  3) Obtain manager-specific accesses (see Tools & Access Matrix).
  4) Schedule recurring 1:1s with direct reports.
  5) Complete "Manager Essentials" self-paced training.

- Day 31–90 (Operationalize):
  1) Run first 1:1 and calibration of goals with each direct report; publish team operating rhythms.
  2) Complete performance calibration and compensation primer with People Ops.
  3) Shadow interviewing as interviewer and hiring debrief facilitator.
  4) Deliver first skip-level meeting (if applicable) and present issues & goals to the lead.

- Day 91–180 (Stabilize):
  1) Lead at least one hiring loop from interview to offer (if responsible for hiring).
  2) Conduct first mid-cycle performance check-ins.
  3) Demonstrate routine feedback cycles and at least one documented development plan.

- Day 181–365 (Grow):
  1) Complete first full performance review cycle for direct reports.
  2) Deliver a manager retrospective and improvement plan.
  3) If applicable, transition IC responsibilities or backfill with People Ops support.

Manager competencies and rubric
- Core skills (required within 90 days):
  - Regular 1:1s with consistent agenda and documented action items.
  - Clear goal-setting aligned to team and company objectives.
  - Timely, constructive feedback and documented coaching conversations.
  - Basic hiring skillset: creating scorecards, structured interviewing, inclusive hiring practices.
- Advanced skills (expected within 12 months):
  - Managing managers (for managers-of-managers): delegation, team-level objectives, upward communication.
  - Resource planning, capacity forecasting, and cross-team coordination.
  - Running postmortems and reliability/quality interventions in partnership with eng-sre and platform teams.

Tools & Access Matrix (how-to table)
- This table below shows key tools, who gets access by default when promoted to manager, and the owner for access requests. People Ops coordinates with IT and Security.

| Tool | Default manager access | Owner for requests | Notes |
| BambooHR (HRIS) | Approver / Manager view | People Ops | Approve PTO and access salary/band info for direct reports |
| Lever (Hiring) | Interviewer + Hiring Manager privileges | Recruiting | Create scorecards, extend offers with recruiting support |
| Workday Payroll | View reports (limited) | Finance | Sensitive access requires justification and approval |
| Slack | Manager channels + private team channels | IT | Add to manager-specific channels; create team channel |
| Confluence | Edit team pages + roadmap templates | Docs team | Template for 1:1 notes and hiring plans |
| PagerDuty / Oncall | Oncall handoff permissions (if team-manages) | Eng SRE | Managers should be aware of escalation policies but not added to primary rotation by default |

Checklist: Before Day 30 (People Ops & Manager)
- People Ops: create role acknowledgement form and schedule People Ops kickoff.
- Manager: complete manager acknowledgement form and confirm team org chart.
- IT/Security: grant accesses in the Tools & Access Matrix.
- Manager: create initial 1:1 cadence and publish meeting schedule.
- Manager: list top three priorities for first 90 days and share with peer buddy.

Hiring and backfill guidance
1) When promoting from within, People Ops will:
   - Coordinate compensation adjustments, document the backfill plan, and identify hiring owner.
   - Run an internal posting for the IC role for a minimum of 3 business days (unless role will be held open for internal mobility only).
2) For external hires into manager roles, the hiring manager should:
   - Align scorecard with People Ops and Recruiting.
   - Share management expectations in the job posting and interview loop.
3) Backfill checklist:
   - Decide whether manager retains IC responsibilities temporarily.
   - Post requisition, assemble interview panel with at least one cross-functional interviewer.
   - Use hiring templates in Confluence for scorecards and offer letters.

Compensation, title, and benefits changes
- Compensation: People Ops will provide a compensation briefing within the first 30 days. Manager promotions typically include base salary adjustment and eligibility for manager bonus bands; increases are made per the total rewards policy.
- Title: Titles should reflect level (e.g., Manager I, Manager II). Consult the Role Framework page for band expectations.
- Benefits: Manager-specific benefits (leadership coaching stipend, conference budget adjustments) are applied within the first payroll cycle following the promotion.

Performance & probation period
- New managers are subject to a 90-day probationary review focused on foundational manager competencies. The review covers documentation of 1:1s, evidence of hiring or interviewing activity, and initial people development plans.
- After probation, a 6-month checkpoint with People Ops and the manager's manager reviews progress and calibrates any further support (coaching, training).

Training curriculum and resources
- Mandatory (complete within 30–90 days):
  - Manager Essentials (self-paced): feedback, 1:1s, performance conversations.
  - Inclusive Hiring & Unconscious Bias (live or recorded).
- Suggested (within 6 months):
  - Compensation calibration workshop.
  - Difficult conversations & conflict resolution (role play).
  - Time & priority planning for people leaders.
- External resources: Redwood covers one external leadership course per year (subject to manager level and People Ops approval).

Common scenarios and playbooks
- New manager inherits underperforming report: run a documented performance improvement plan (PIP-lite) with People Ops involvement.
- Manager split across two teams: define primary team ownership and clarify reporting in the org chart; People Ops will evaluate workload and recommend capacity changes.
- Manager hired externally with limited prior people management experience: pair with internal peer buddy and assign a coach for first 6 months.

FAQ
- Q: Who updates payroll/title in systems?
  A: People Ops initiates changes; Finance validates payroll inputs.
- Q: When is a manager eligible for bonus bands?
  A: Eligibility dates and amounts are governed by the total rewards schedule; People Ops will brief managers during the first 30 days.

Metrics and success signals
- Manager onboard success is measured by:
  - 95% completion of required training within 90 days.
  - Establishment of 1:1 cadence with all direct reports within 14 days.
  - At least one documented hiring process or development plan within 180 days.

Appendix: Templates and sample artifacts
- 1:1 agenda template (Confluence link): include wins, blockers, career discussion, action items.
- Manager responsibilities checklist (copyable checklist to paste into Confluence).
- Sample manager development plan (timeline and measurable goals).

Contacts and next steps
- People Ops primary: Priya Kapoor (people-ops@redwood.ai)
- Recruiting partner: Marcus Lee (recruiting@redwood.ai)
- HRIS / IT access: IT Support (it-support@redwood.ai)

Review cycle
- This doc will be reviewed annually and after every major role framework change. For urgent updates, contact the People Ops owner.
